meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 装上后,当新用户说想开始使用 omo 时,Claude 会进入向导模式:依序带用户走过功能导览、迁移帮助、历史会话分析等环节,获同意后算出价值估算,并全程用记忆工具记录用户信息,最后提出首次 init-deep 建议。
howto.when: 当新用户第一次要求开始使用 omo 时自动触发,只自动开始一次;之后可随时用 `senpi --onboard` 再次唤起。

say.text: 我是新用户,想开始使用 omo,带我走一遍新手流程。
say.note: Claude 会启动新手引导,带用户走完各环节。

say.text: 我想从 Claude Code 迁移过来,帮我看看现有配置。
say.note: 技能会扫描旧配置,给出等待你确认的迁移计划。

say.text: 可以分析我以前的编码会话,估算 omo 能帮我省多少成本吗?
say.note: 经你同意后,它会挖掘历史记录并按本地日志估算节省。

howto.what_en: Installed, when a new user asks to start with omo, Claude turns guide: it runs a feature tour, migration help, past-session archaeology, optional value estimates, records memories as it goes, and ends with an init-deep proposal.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically when a new user first asks to get started with omo (only once ever); it can be reopened anytime with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I am a new user and want to start with omo. Walk me through onboarding.
say_en.note: It starts the guided onboarding tour for you.

say_en.text: I want to move from Claude Code; can you look at my existing config?
say_en.note: It proposes a migration plan and waits for your OK.

say_en.text: Can you analyze my past coding sessions to estimate what omo would save?
say_en.note: With permission it mines history and estimates savings.
